body:
_Migrated from issue #842, filed 2026-07-11._

Credit: @filiporlo (#400).

Create a standalone `cwasync.koplugin` repository with independent release tags and plugin ZIP assets, so KOReader Updates Manager/appstore.koplugin only reports updates when the plugin itself changes rather than on every CWNG app release. Preserve the existing plugin version lockstep tests and document the manager URL.
title: KOReader sync plugin: move releases to a dedicated repository
